What problem does this solve, and who benefits?

## Privacy review

- [ ] No profile, resume, application, contact, compensation, database, backup,
      export, credential, or personal absolute path is included
- [ ] No telemetry, hosted storage, authentication, automatic submission, or
      automatic outreach was added without an explicit product-scope decision
- [ ] Personal preferences are configurable or remain local

## Validation

- [ ] `.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts\release_check.py`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has automated coverage
- [ ] Dashboard changes were checked on desktop and mobile
- [ ] MCP contract changes were exercised through the stdio smoke path
- [ ] Schema changes were tested as an idempotent upgrade on temporary data

## Screenshots or evidence

Include only sanitized screenshots or output. Never upload real application data.
